title: The Constraint Ladder
prompt: Define `Iterable` (begin/end) and `SizedIterable` (refining it with size), then three `category` overloads — sized, iterable-only, and other — and verify subsumption routes each type to the right rung.

tests.name: vector lands on the sized rung
tests.hint: Subsumption: SizedIterable (more constrained) wins for anything with begin/end/size.

tests.name: begin/end-only lands on iterable
tests.hint: RangeOnly has begin/end but no size — Iterable only.

tests.name: everything else lands on other
tests.hint: The unconstrained overload catches the rest.
